l1.text: Here's Lifted Trucks' year to date, January through September.

l2.text: We've sold six thousand four hundred forty-five trucks, up thirty-seven percent on last year. And September was our biggest month yet, at seven hundred seventy-seven.

l3.text: The footprint keeps growing. Five new stores opened this year, for eighteen dealerships, and Texas and Oklahoma now outsell Arizona.

l4.text: Revenue reached five hundred nineteen million dollars, up forty percent, with about ten thousand seven hundred dollars of gross on every truck.

l5.text: Adjusted EBITDA is sixteen point seven million, up thirty-six percent, and it's grown every quarter.

l6.text: Demand is strong. Leads are up forty-four percent, to more than forty-two thousand.

l7.text: Three things to watch. The newest stores are ramping slower than plan. Days supply is fifty-two, against a forty-five day goal. And Texas recon still takes about thirteen days.

l8.text: Next year's plan calls for ten thousand four hundred trucks, and thirty-two million in EBITDA. Let's finish this year strong.
